x: Other juniors who have had a good season are John Mitchell,John Martin, Phil Smith,Bob Nelson,Dave Nicklin and Adrian Major. Many others who are under the guidance of Tom Carter are improving fast and the seniors will surely benefit in the very near future.
In the quarter mile Philip Smith recorded a personal best and with a little more experience should improve this time even further. 100y 2.C.Martin 10.4 4.D.Nicklin 10.8

Dave Nicklin improved 9" on his previous best with a leap of 20'9¾" to take 3rd place,only 4" covering the first three. In the absence of Jim Vivian (just out of hospital after an appendicitis operation) the Belgrave flag was still kept flying in the sprints with good efforts by Chris Martin and Denis Gleeson.
We are badly in need of some Senior quarter milers. 100y 1.C.Martin 10.7 3.D.Nicklin 11.2

Perhaps the unluckiest athlete of the evening was Dave Nicklin who was doomed to finish second to Denis in each race. John Martin,better known for his shot-putting activities, nearly caused an upset by almost catching Adrian Major on the tape in the 'half'.

John Kelly put up the fastest time in the heats of the youths 880y (2:07.0) but couldn't quite repeat the performance in the final (2:10.0), a good performance nevertheless. Other Belgrave members to do well were Dave Nicklin 3rd in the Long Jump (20'1½") and Adrian Major 4th in the Mile(4:35.2 [?]).
